a2-46.title: Communicative Challenge: What Does the Recipe Need?
a2-46.scenario: Ildikó invites Meg into her kitchen to learn the family goulash recipe, and asks what ingredients a good recipe needs. You (Meg) say it needs meat, onion, paprika, pepper and salt.
a2-46.prompt: Tell Ildikó the main ingredients and spices the dish needs.
cues: Name the ingredients and spices the dish needs
a2-46.target: Hús, hagyma, paprika, bors és só kell hozzá.
a2-46.english: It needs meat, onion, paprika, pepper and salt.
a2-46.canDo: I can name the main ingredients and spices in a recipe.

a2-47.title: Communicative Challenge: Knife, Fork and Spoon
a2-47.scenario: Ildikó and Meg talk about cooking tools in the kitchen. You (Meg) eat the soup with a spoon, and the meat with a knife and fork.
a2-47.prompt: Tell Ildikó what you eat the soup with, and what you eat the meat with.
cues: Say what you eat the soup with
Say what you eat the meat with
a2-47.target: A levest kanállal eszem. A húst késsel és villával eszem.
a2-47.english: I eat the soup with a spoon. I eat the meat with a knife and fork.
a2-47.canDo: I can name basic cooking tools.

a2-48.title: Communicative Challenge: Let's Cook Together
a2-48.scenario: Ildikó asks Meg how she would write down the first steps of the recipe. You (Meg) say: cut some onion, boil some water, and suggest cooking together.
a2-48.prompt: Give Ildikó the first two steps as commands, and suggest that you cook together.
cues: Tell someone to cut onion and boil water
a2-48.target: Vágj hagymát, aztán forralj vizet! Főzzünk együtt!
a2-48.english: Cut some onion, then boil some water! Let's cook together!
a2-48.canDo: I can give a simple cooking instruction using the imperative.

a2-49.title: Communicative Challenge: Cut It Up
a2-49.scenario: Ildikó is writing down the goulash recipe and asks Meg for the next steps. You (Meg) say: cut up the onion, then add the meat.
a2-49.prompt: Give Ildikó two instructions: cut up the onion, then add the meat.
cues: Tell someone to cut up the onion
Tell someone to add the meat
a2-49.target: Vágd fel a hagymát! Add hozzá a húst!
a2-49.english: Cut up the onion! Add the meat!
a2-49.canDo: I can give a command about a specific, definite thing.

a2-50.title: Communicative Challenge: Making Gulyás
a2-50.scenario: Ildikó asks Meg to explain how the goulash is made. You (Meg) cut up the onion and the garlic, put them into the pot, then put in the meat and the paprika too.
a2-50.prompt: Explain to Ildikó how to make the dish, step by step.
cues: Say to cut up the onion and the garlic
Say to put them in the pot and then add the meat and paprika
a2-50.target: Vágd fel a hagymát és a fokhagymát. Tedd a fazékba, aztán tedd bele a húst és a paprikát is.
a2-50.english: Cut up the onion and the garlic. Put them in the pot, then put the meat and the paprika into it too.
a2-50.canDo: I can describe making a traditional Hungarian dish from start to finish.

a2-50-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Goulash Card
a2-50-consolidation.scenario: Ildikó asks Meg to write the goulash recipe card. You (Meg) say what the dish needs and give one step with a knife.
a2-50-consolidation.prompt: Tell Ildikó which ingredients the goulash needs, and tell her to cut up the onion with a knife.
cues: Tell her to cut up the onion with a knife
a2-50-consolidation.target: A gulyáshoz hús, hagyma és paprika kell. Vágd fel a hagymát késsel!
a2-50-consolidation.english: The goulash needs meat, onion and paprika. Cut up the onion with a knife!
a2-50-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about ingredients, spices, and cooking tools.
